title: The Chow immersion is a closed immersion and the pulled-back O(1) is relatively ample
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $g:Z\to S$ and $\pi:X'\to Z$ be proper morphisms [def-weil-proper-morphism], and let $j:X'\to\mathbf P^m_S$ be an immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] into projective space over $S$ [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change] with $p\circ j=g\circ\pi$, where $p:\mathbf P^m_S\to S$ is the structure morphism. Put $g'=g\circ\pi$ and $\mathcal L=j^*\mathcal O_{\mathbf P^m_S}(1)$ [def-pc-module-pullback], an invertible $\mathcal O_{X'}$-module [def-sc-invertible-module]. Then: (1) $j$ is a closed immersion, so $g'$ is projective [def-pc-projective-morphism]; (2) the induced morphism $(j,\pi):X'\to\mathbf P^m_S\times_SZ=\mathbf P^m_Z$ is a closed immersion, so $\pi$ is projective, and $\mathcal L\cong(j,\pi)^*\mathcal O_{\mathbf P^m_Z}(1)$; (3) for every affine open $V\subseteq S$ the restriction $\mathcal L|_{g'^{-1}(V)}$ is ample [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module], and for every affine open $W\subseteq Z$ the restriction $\mathcal L|_{\pi^{-1}(W)}$ is ample.
